Since this is a new comic, I'd appreciate it if you could point out any mistakes you find in the comments, that will help me keep better track of the quality 😊

Description:
In a world where high-tier magic is heavily regulated, Nixa - a brilliant but socially shunned 20-year-old goblin alchemist - decides to take the industry into her own hands. Operating in secret out of a room rented from Evelynn, a strict 200-year-old elven landlady, Nixa brews an illegal, highly concentrated enhancement potion to cure her own physical insecurities. But basement chemistry is an unpredictable science.

When her experimental dosage proves to be vastly more potent than calculated, a simple test spirals out of control, triggering a chain reaction of massive, unstoppable bodily transformations. As the overwhelming side effects accidentally spill over onto her authoritative landlady, both women are about to discover that when you tamper with the absolute limits of biology, the consequences are incredibly huge and spark an irresistible desire to keep doing it.
